messages:
maya: kicking off intake for Ignite-11B bring-up. request: prioritize hosted + dedicated first, private later. attaching baseline eval targets and quantization plan. can we confirm owners and a minimal staged rollout?

liam: +1. quick Q — what's the primary eval suite we should gate on? latency / cost / quality thresholds?

maya: use raven-evals-v2 as the canonical suite. metrics: generation quality (pass@1 / rouge) + safety checks + task-specific WER where applicable. acceptance criteria: quality degradation <= 2% relative to raven-13b baseline, error rate < 0.5%, latency P95 <= 450ms hosted, <= 220ms dedicated. cost target: <= 0.6x current unit cost.

sophia: I'll own quant experiments. plan: fp16 baseline, then int8 (QLoRA-like) and int4 (nf4) if stable. will run perf/quality sweep on dev cluster. need model artifact path and expected max sequence length.

maya: model artifact: s3://redwood-models/ignite/11b/v1.tar.gz, hf path /redwood/models/ignite-11b/v1. max seq len 4096 for typical traffic, but tests should include 8192 long-tail.

ajay: canary routing proposal: hosted start 0.5% -> 2% -> 10% -> 25% over 24-48h windows with automated checks between steps. dedicated: start 5% -> 20% -> 50% (since we want throughput signal). private: hold until hosted/dedicated green. fallback rules: auto-fallback to raven-13b if any of: quality drop >2% on eval set, error rate >0.5% (5xx or malformed outputs), or latency SLO breach at P95.

jen: QA will run focused prompt sets for hallucination/regression detection on each canary step and provide a short report. will flag any safety/regression findings.

sophia: smoke test command I'll run before canary:
```bash
# quick smoke for ignite-11b int8
python infra/eval/run_eval.py --model ignite-11b --suite raven-evals-v2 --quant int8 --batch 1 --timeout 60
```

deploy-bot: canary deployment initiated for ignite-11b hosted pool (0.5% traffic) — deploy-id: dp-ignite-2249-01

infra-bot: observed memory pressure on one int4 node during long-seq (8192) test — OOM at 1.2s alloc. adjusting kv-slice and prefetch settings, retesting.

liam: capture distributed traces and sample logs for any malformed outputs. enable prefix caching on the canary route for repeated prompts to get a realistic perf signal. add token-level cost traces.

maya: owners: sophia (quant + perf), ajay (rollout & runbook), jen (QA/regr tests), liam (observability & traces). please add a monitoring dash: per-route P95 latency, error rate, quality delta (from eval runs), and unit cost.

sophia: noted. I'll post the initial int8 vs fp16 matrix and perf numbers in this thread once ready. planning first pass today, deeper sweep tomorrow.

ajay: agreed on overall plan. I'll open a runbook PR with the canary steps, rollback conditions, and emergency contact list. expected rollout timeline: smoke -> int8 perf sweep -> hosted canary -> expand -> dedicated canary -> full rollout.

maya: thanks — :thumbsup: Please drop links to the PRs and eval artifacts here. we'll stand up a short sync if any red flags appear during the first 24h.

jen: QA will post checklist results in this thread after each canary increment.

sophia: starting fp16 baseline now. will tag artifacts as ignite-11b/v1-fp16, then ignite-11b/v1-int8, ignite-11b/v1-int4.

deploy-bot: canary traffic increased to 2% hosted after green smoke (deploy-id: dp-ignite-2249-02).

infra-bot: int4 OOM fixed by kv-slice tweak; retest shows stable for seq<=4096 but still flaky at 8192. recommend holding int4 for dedicated-only trials for now.

liam: action items recorded. will create observability tickets and a short dashboard template.

maya: closing the intake — thanks everyone. we'll reconvene if QA flags anything. :raised_hands:
